; Switch the meeting-note calendar button between its stock action and AppLoad.
; Only the non-secret launcher preference is read. No running backend is needed.
; Ported to 3.29.1.0 (Paper Pro Move): `popup` is now an inline EventsPopup object, so it is switched off with a
; Binding instead of being rewritten (wrapping an object declaration in `?:` made qmldiff panic).
VERSION 3.29.1.0

AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/modules/integrations/calendar/qml/CalendarActions.qml
    IMPORT net.asivery.AppLoad 1.0
    TRAVERSE ?#root
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            property bool nextcloudCalendarEnabled: true
            Timer {
                interval: 1000
                running: true
                repeat: true
                triggeredOnStart: true
                onTriggered: {
                    var request =  new  XMLHttpRequest();
                    request.onreadystatechange = function() {
                        if (request.readyState !== 4) { return; }
                        try {
                            var settings = JSON.parse(request.responseText);
                            if (typeof settings.enabled === "boolean") {
                                root.nextcloudCalendarEnabled = settings.enabled;
                            }
                        } catch (error) { }
                    };
                    request.open("GET", "file:///home/root/.local/share/nextcloud-calendar/launcher.json");
                    request.send();
                }
            }
            Binding {
                target: root
                property: "popup"
                value: null
                when: root.nextcloudCalendarEnabled
            }
        }
        REBUILD supportedViews
            LOCATE BEFORE ALL
            INSERT STREAM / root.nextcloudCalendarEnabled ? ["myfiles"] : ( /
            LOCATE AFTER ALL
            INSERT STREAM / ) /
        END REBUILD
        REBUILD onActionClicked
            LOCATE AFTER STREAM / { /
            INSERT {
                if (root.nextcloudCalendarEnabled) {
                    AppLoadLauncher.launchApplication("org.remarkable.nextcloudcalendar", [], {}, false);
                    return;
                }
            }
        END REBUILD
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
